newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm prices soften in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm prices soften in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil and olein prices softened further in late trading on Wednesday due to sustained weak sentiment, traders said.
One trader in Medan said further weakening of Malaysian prices seemed to have dampened domestic sentiment.
"Buyers are reluctant to commit at present stage. They have stayed on the sidelines or tried to bid down," he said.
Traders said some buying interest for crude palm oil (CPO) was seen at around 1,190 rupiah/kg while sellers' indication was at around 1,200 rupiah/kg.
They said no tender was scheduled on Wednesday, but probably there could be one on Thursday.
One trader said it was now unlikely that the state commodity regulator Bulog would intervene in the market because prices have declined to below its target level.
He said the market for olein was quoted at around 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and Surabaya and 1,400 rupiah/kg in Medan.
